name: reminders-mcp
description: Read, create, complete and update your Apple Reminders. Runs on your Mac and never deletes anything.
long_description: Lets Claude work with the Reminders app on your own Mac: see your lists, read what is due, add a reminder with a date, notes and priority, check one off, or change it. Everything happens on this Mac, through the Reminders app; reminders sync to your other devices through your own iCloud, as always. There is no account and no token. The first time Claude uses it, macOS asks whether Claude may control Reminders: click OK. Nothing is deleted, and nothing runs on its own.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: Your reminder lists, with how many open reminders each has.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: Reminders in one list, filtered by status and due date.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder with a title, notes, list, due date and priority.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.description: Check a reminder off. It is kept, not deleted.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Change a reminder's title, notes, due date or priority, or reopen it.
